transcript: If you want 26 to be different, do not wait for motivation, do not wait for the perfect moment. Do these things quietly, consistently, and your life will begin to change on its own. First, simplify your inputs, what you eat, what you watch, what you listen to before sleep. A calm body creates a calm future. Second, walk every day even when it feels small. Movement tells the nervous system, I am alive, I am safe, I am moving forward. Third, protect your mornings. Do not give your best energy to noise, messages, or fear. Give it to your breath, your body, your intention. Fourth, remove what drains you, not with anger, not with explanation, just with distance. Peace grows where drama cannot reach. Fifth, choose one practice and stay with it, not ten habits. One, consistency is the true teacher. If you do these things, you will not need to chase change. Your energy will shift, your focus will return, and 26 will meet a version of you that is clearer, stronger, and at peace. This is not a new life, this is you returning to your rhythm. Watching will not change your life, practice will. I created the 30-day healing journey for those who are ready to stop consuming and start transforming. If you feel this message in your body, not just your mind, go to the link in my bio and begin today.
